verdict: Regex denylist approach is structurally unsound, not incomplete. Two confirmed bypasses (reference-style links, angle-bracket-wrapped URLs) plus three more constructible without changing the threat model (backslash-escaping, HTML entity encoding, embedded whitespace/control characters per the OWASP javascript: URI filter bypass cheat sheet) -- all stem from the same root cause: the regex scans raw source bytes for a scheme: substring, but CommonMark link-destination resolution (and any real renderer) applies escape processing, entity decoding, and whitespace normalization the regex never implements.
